_comment: Curated evergreen-rescue list: EXISTING /{metro}/event/{slug}/ URLs that ranked (90-day GSC clicks+impressions pulled and SHOWN per ~/Projects/seo-ops/SEO-POLICY.md) and then died in the 410 lifecycle. generate-seo-pages.mjs regenerates each as a permanent 200 recap page at the SAME URL (no Event JSON-LD, no date claims beyond lastHeld), and the event-seo-manifest `evergreen` array exempts the slug from the edge guard's 410. Inclusion bar: ranked-and-dead ONLY — metrics shown first, list stays curated, never systemic. `match` is a case-insensitive regex against live event titles to cross-link next year's edition when it is back in the dataset; recurrence "unverified" entries must not claim the event returns every year. Note: this list is complementary to data/annual-events.json (/{metro}/annual/ guides) — boston minuteman-library-crawl exists in BOTH (annualSlug cross-references it); the /annual/ page is the year-round guide, the /event/ evergreen page preserves the ranked URL itself.

bay-area.title: Milpitas Red, White & Boom
bay-area.description: Milpitas' city-run Fourth of July celebration at the Milpitas Sports Center: an evening of live music and food vendors capped by the city's fireworks show.

bay-area.title: Hillsborough Memorial Day Parade
bay-area.description: Hillsborough's hometown Memorial Day parade and remembrance ceremony — a family-scale Peninsula tradition with local schools, scouts, and veterans' groups marching.

bay-area.title: Healdsburg Independence Day Fireworks
bay-area.description: Healdsburg's hometown Fourth of July fireworks show, launched from the Healdsburg High School area — Sonoma County families picnic nearby and watch the display over town.

los-angeles.title: Canoga Park Memorial Day Parade
los-angeles.description: The West San Fernando Valley's long-running Memorial Day parade along Sherman Way in Canoga Park, with marching bands, veterans' groups, and community floats.

los-angeles.title: Los Angeles National Cemetery Memorial Day Ceremony
los-angeles.description: The annual Memorial Day observance at Los Angeles National Cemetery in West LA — a flag-placing and remembrance ceremony honoring the veterans interred there.

los-angeles.title: Brand Summer Music Series
los-angeles.description: The Brand Library's free summer concert series in Glendale — family-friendly music at the Brand Library Art Center.

los-angeles.title: Dino West Adventure
los-angeles.description: A dinosaur-themed adventure program for kids hosted at the Carson Library.

seattle.title: Bellevue Family 4th
seattle.description: Bellevue's free Fourth of July festival at Downtown Park: an afternoon of family activities, food, and live music leading into the Eastside's biggest fireworks show.

houston.title: Rosenberg Family 4th Celebration
houston.description: Rosenberg's free Independence Day celebration at Seabourne Creek Nature Park — family activities, food vendors, and live entertainment finished with a fireworks display.

austin.title: Cedar Park Sparktacular
austin.description: Cedar Park's free July 4th festival at Milburn Park: kids' activities, live music, and food trucks through the evening, capped by the city fireworks show.

austin.title: Round Rock Frontier Days
austin.description: Round Rock's July 4th festival at Old Settlers Park: a day of live music at the Lakeview Stage and Pavilion, food vendors, and family activities capped by the city fireworks show.

austin.title: Georgetown 4th of July Celebration
austin.description: Georgetown's family Independence Day celebration at San Gabriel Park — an evening of food, music, and family activities finishing with the city's fireworks display.

austin.title: Science Show with Mad Science
austin.description: A hands-on science demonstration show by Mad Science, presented at the Cedar Park Public Library.

austin.title: Modern Dinosaurs: Raptors and Ravens in Flight
austin.description: Wildlife Revealed brings live ravens, falcons, and owls to the Round Rock Public Library for a program on the modern dinosaurs living among us — raptors and ravens in flight.

honolulu.title: Kauai Hospice Concert in the Sky
honolulu.description: Kauai's signature July 4th benefit for Kauai Hospice at Vidinha Stadium in Lihue — an all-day family festival of live music and food ending with the island's largest fireworks show.

honolulu.title: Keiki ID with HPD
honolulu.description: Free child identification cards — photo, fingerprints, and emergency info — issued by the Hawaii Police Department at the Hilo Public Library.

san-diego.title: USS Midway Legacy Week
san-diego.description: The USS Midway Museum's Memorial Day-week program honoring service members, with special ceremonies and commemorative activities aboard the carrier on San Diego's waterfront.

san-diego.title: Fort Rosecrans Memorial Day Ceremony
san-diego.description: The annual Memorial Day ceremony at Fort Rosecrans National Cemetery on Point Loma, one of San Diego's most moving remembrance traditions overlooking the bay.

san-diego.title: Craft Unraveled

san-diego.title: House of Colombia Lawn Program
san-diego.description: Family programs on the lawn at the House of Colombia, one of Balboa Park's international cottages.

san-diego.title: Nat at Night
san-diego.venue: San Diego Natural History Museum (The Nat)
san-diego.description: The Nat's after-hours evening program — access to the San Diego Natural History Museum's exhibits in Balboa Park after closing time.

new-york-city.title: Brooklyn Memorial Day Parade
new-york-city.description: Bay Ridge's Brooklyn Memorial Day Parade — one of the oldest continuously running Memorial Day parades in the country, marching down Third Avenue with veterans' groups, bands, and local organizations.

new-york-city.title: Kids in Motion Superhero Day
new-york-city.description: Kids in Motion's Superhero Day at St. James Park — playground games and superhero fun for neighborhood families.

washington-dc.title: Carnival in DE Capital
washington-dc.venue: Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Library
washington-dc.description: A Caribbean carnival celebration at DC's Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Library — music, dance, and family activities in the central library's event space.

washington-dc.title: PokeFair Renaissance at the Montgomery County Fairgrounds
washington-dc.description: A Pokémon trading-card and collectibles fair at the Montgomery County Fairgrounds in Gaithersburg — vendors, trading tables, and family-friendly fandom under one roof.

washington-dc.title: Library Day at the National Museum of Women in the Arts
washington-dc.venue: National Museum of Women in the Arts
washington-dc.description: DC Public Library's Library Day at the National Museum of Women in the Arts — free museum exploring during a community day for library families.

boston.title: Dorchester Memorial Day Parade
boston.description: Dorchester's neighborhood Memorial Day parade — veterans' groups, marching bands, and community organizations processing along Dorchester Avenue, a Boston tradition for generations.

boston.title: Minuteman Library Crawl
boston.description: The Minuteman Library Network's summer library crawl: visit participating libraries across the network, collect stamps, and earn prizes — a free end-of-summer family quest around Greater Boston.

boston.description: A weeklong drop-in escape room at the Newton Free Library celebrating Winnie-the-Pooh's 100th birthday — search the Hundred Acre Wood to find Christopher Robin's friends and bring them to the picnic.

boston.title: Kindergarten Transition Meetup

boston.description: A transition meetup for families with kids starting kindergarten, held at Hunneman Hall in Brookline Village.

chicago.title: Palatine Hometown Fest Family Day

chicago.title: Legendary Late Hours at the Field Museum
chicago.description: The Field Museum's late-night evening program — exhibits open after hours with live music and special programming.

miami.title: Hollywood Beach Star-Spangled Spectacular
miami.description: Hollywood Beach's July 4th Star-Spangled Spectacular at the Hollywood Beach Theater on the Broadwalk: an evening of live music and family fun ending with fireworks over the ocean.

miami.title: Florida Panthers Summer Reading Tour
miami.description: The Florida Panthers' summer reading tour stops at Miami-Dade libraries — players, the team mascot, and reading-themed activities encouraging kids to read over summer break.

miami.title: 3D Paper Art
miami.venue: Marta Beth Friedman Stirling Road Branch
miami.description: A 3D paper art craft program for kids at the Stirling Road Branch of the Broward County Library.

dallas-fort-worth.title: Grand Prairie Stars & Stripes Fireworks
dallas-fort-worth.description: Grand Prairie's annual Fourth of July celebration at Lone Star Park — daytime racing capped by the Stars & Stripes fireworks show over the track.

dallas-fort-worth.title: The Juggling Experience with The Ramazinis
dallas-fort-worth.description: The Ramazinis' family juggling show at the Dallas Public Library — comedy, unicycles, and juggling for all ages.

atlanta.title: Green Market at Piedmont Park
atlanta.description: Piedmont Park's weekly green market — local farmers and vendors every Saturday in the park.
